facts.fact: The ITU repository lists Digital Morocco 2030 as the country's strategy and says the countries it lists have adopted one; no adopting act is named, so this is dated by the repository's 2025 publication year.
The repository gives the time frame of Digital Morocco 2030 as 2024 - 2030.
The repository names the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform as lead/owner of Digital Morocco 2030.
